items.note: All three samples have a teal workspace band holding a regular-weight 'Overview' title and an ink Refresh button, four outlined stat cards, a throughput chart card with a 32px sticker beside its title, a recent-activity card, and a bordered projects table with pill filters. In samples 1 and 2 the chart card stops about 60px above the taller activity card next to it, which leaves an empty gap in the row.

The phone layout has an ink current-page pill in the nav strip, then the teal band with the title, sentence and ink Refresh, then 2×2 outlined stat cards, the chart card with its sticker, the activity list, and project rows stacked as label/value blocks inside one bordered box. Nothing is cut off. The leftover column-label strip above the blocks was already reported in an earlier review.

Dark mode keeps the same structure on a black ground with raised dark cards. The current-page pill and Refresh turn paper-filled, the chart bars are paper (sample 2 makes the last bar pink), and the stacked project blocks and status pills stay readable.

On a black ground with a dark sidebar and raised cards, the teal band carries a paper Refresh, the chart bars turn paper, and there is still exactly one pink accent. The chart card in samples 1 and 2 still ends above the activity card, leaving the same empty gap as in light mode.

Projects gets its own band color (yellow in samples 1 and 3, periwinkle in sample 2) with an ink rule under it. Below it are 'All projects' with a count, pill status filters, a filter input, and the bordered table with an ink rule under its header, underlined project links and outlined status pills. The hierarchy is clear and the screen is dense and flat, like the reference's listing pages.

The band collapses to the title plus one sentence. Under it come the filter pills, the input, and the projects as stacked blocks inside one bordered box: name link, team, then owner/status/budget/date rows. Nothing overflows sideways at phone width.

Dark mode keeps the bright yellow or periwinkle band with ink text over a black page. The selected 'All' pill, the paper current-page nav pill and the outlined status pills all follow the dark mapping, and the table stays inside its bordered box.

The stacked project blocks sit in a raised dark box under the band. Status pills keep their icon plus word, and the paper-filled current-page pill in the top strip marks Projects. No overlap or clipping.

The detail page shares its section's band color. The band holds the breadcrumb, a regular-weight title, the team and owner meta line, an outlined status pill and Overview/Tasks/Files pill tabs, with a raised selected tab. Below is one outlined card with the description and four subtle stat wells (sample 2 uses hairline-separated columns instead).

At phone width the band stacks the breadcrumb, title, meta, status pill and tab pills cleanly. The detail card's stats reflow to a 2×2 grid of wells (samples 1 and 3) or rule-separated pairs (sample 2), with no cramped or cut-off text.

The band stays the section color with ink text. In dark mode the selected tab and the status pill turn dark-filled with light text, which reads well on the band, and the detail card is a raised dark panel with darker wells.
Same structure as light mode on black: the band carries a dark selected tab pill, and the raised detail card has dark stat wells. Contrast and spacing hold up.

The team band uses a different color from projects in every sample, so the color tells you which section you are in. Below it is a bordered table: square outlined initials, names, underlined email links, and role, location and project-count columns on hairline rules. It's plain and dense, as the spec's data-table context asks.

The band collapses to the title and one sentence, and each member becomes a block inside one bordered box: initials square, name, email link, then role, location and active-project rows. Rhythm is even and nothing is clipped.

The periwinkle or yellow band keeps ink text over a black page. The table is a dark bordered box with light text and outlined initials squares, and the paper current-page pill marks Team in the sidebar.
Member blocks sit in a raised dark box with light names, muted labels and underlined email links. The paper-filled current-page pill marks Team, and the layout matches light mode without overflow.

findings.summary: On the desktop overview, the chart card and the recent-activity card sit side by side at different heights. The chart card ends about 60px above the activity card, which leaves an empty pocket in the row; sample 3 stretches both cards to the same height.
